text:
Maya (support): FYI escalating a customer who hit our rerank endpoint with a weird failure. They get a generic error and no clear hint which field blew the budget. Customer says: 'we sent a query + ~120 docs, some docs are long, it just returns 400 and scores = []'. They want repro steps and a clearer error message.

Jensen (eng-runtime): Thanks — can you paste the raw request and the exact response body (redact PII)? If we have request_id from the router that helps trace logs.

Maya (support): request_id: req_2026-03-10_9b8c7a. Response body customer saw: `{"error":"input_too_large","message":"input exceeds allowed size"}` — no breakdown. Customer provided a sanitized cURL repro: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"'$(printf 'long_query_segment%.0s' {1..250})'","documents":["'$(printf 'doc_long_text%.0s' {1..120})'"]}'
```
They say query alone is ~8k chars, combined doc tokens ~140k tokens.

Ravi (SRE): I pulled the router trace for req_2026-03-10_9b8c7a — backend returned a 400 at the runtime ingestion step with an EVAL token_count check. Our logs show token_count_total=142374, max_allowed=65536, but the error forwarded to client was flattened to `input_too_large`.

Jensen (eng-runtime): OK that matches. Two issues: 1) we drop per-field metadata when passing the error up, so customer can't tell whether `query` or `documents` caused the overflow, and 2) some customers saw empty score arrays which is our fallback path when we short-circuit before model invocation. I can prepare a patch to enhance the error payload to include: `{"error":"input_limit_exceeded","details":{"field":"documents[37]","tokens":9523,"total_tokens":142374,"max_tokens":65536}}` — would that help support and customers?

Maya (support): Yes please. Having `field` + offending token count + current/limit numbers is exactly what the customer asked for. Also request the API recommend mitigation steps, e.g. 'truncate docs, return snippets, or use batch split'.

Ari (product): Suggest wording for UX: "message":"input limit exceeded: total tokens 142374 > max 65536. Offending field: documents[37] (9523 tokens). Suggested actions: shorten query, reduce number/length of documents, or use pagination/batching. See https://redwood.ai/docs/rerank-limits for examples." — this is more actionable than current text.

Jensen (eng-runtime): I'll open a small PR to change the propagated error shape and add the suggested message text. ETA: patch + unit tests today, roll to canary tomorrow. We'll include a router mapping so existing clients still get `input_too_large` for backward compatibility and the new `details` object when available.

Ravi (SRE): After patch we should add a log line that records `offending_field` and short-circuit reason so support can find traces quickly. I'll add that to the runbook.

Maya (support): Great — I'll reply to the customer with a tentative workaround: 1) try sending only top 10 docs, 2) truncate query OR send documents in batches of 30, 3) if they need full rerank, recommend using our bulk/async rerank (if eligible). I'll follow up once the new error shape is live. :thumbsup:

customer-bot: Thanks for the quick triage — will try the batch approach and report back.
